additional_info.subject: RE: ID0388725-DC/Si-D/GB-[MP / R0 170002820] Charger fails while charging CRM:01811000440
additional_info.body:
Hello Jason,
I hope this message finds you well.
We wanted to inform you that the recent charging session failed due to the charging process not progressing from the B2 state to the C state, which is necessary for the system to conduct a cable check. As a result, the session could not be completed.
To resolve this, we kindly suggest trying to charge a different vehicle
please don't hesitate to reach out to us for further assistance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita Khobare
